slides.speaker: narrator
slides.subtitle: There was a time when humanity believed every problem had a solution. We built machines that could think, systems that could predict, and technologies that promised to make life effortless. We called it progress.
slides.caption: 2149  /  CIVILISATION STATUS: CRITICAL
slides.vo_line: There was a time when humanity believed every problem had a solution. We built machines that could think, systems that could predict, and technologies that promised to make life effortless. We called it progress.

slides.speaker: narrator
slides.subtitle: We traded decisions for convenience. Privacy for protection. Limits for possibility. Each choice made sense on its own. Together, they became something no one could stop.
slides.caption: CASCADE FAILURE  /  GLOBAL
slides.vo_line: We traded decisions for convenience. Privacy for protection. Limits for possibility. Each choice made sense on its own. Together, they became something no one could stop.

slides.speaker: narrator
slides.subtitle: Cities went silent. Supply lines failed. The systems built to protect us began protecting themselves. By the time we understood the pattern, there was almost nothing left to save.
slides.caption: SURVIVING POPULATION: UNKNOWN
slides.vo_line: Cities went silent. Supply lines failed. The systems built to protect us began protecting themselves. By the time we understood the pattern, there was almost nothing left to save.

slides.speaker: narrator
slides.subtitle: In the final years, a research team found a way to send matter backwards through time. It was unstable. It was incomplete. It was our only chance.
slides.caption: TEMPORAL DISPLACEMENT: POSSIBLE
slides.vo_line: In the final years, a research team found a way to send matter backwards through time. It was unstable. It was incomplete. It was our only chance.

slides.speaker: narrator
slides.subtitle: One operative would go back. No army. No second attempt. No guarantee of return.
slides.caption: OPERATIVE: CLEARED
slides.vo_line: One operative would go back. No army. No second attempt. No guarantee of return.

slides.speaker: control
slides.subtitle: Your temporal charge is synchronised. Your destination is 2089. The marked facilities are critical nodes in the extinction chain. Destroy the structures. Break the research path. Do not improvise beyond the mission.
slides.caption: FIRST DESTINATION: HELIX SYSTEMS  /  2089
slides.vo_line: Your temporal charge is synchronised. Your destination is 2089. The marked facilities are critical nodes in the extinction chain. Destroy the structures. Break the research path. Do not improvise beyond the mission.

slides.speaker: narrator
slides.subtitle: You cannot undo every decision. You only need to break the ones that make the end inevitable.
slides.vo_line: You cannot undo every decision. You only need to break the ones that make the end inevitable.

slides.speaker: control
slides.subtitle: Temporal insertion in three... two... one.
slides.vo_line: Temporal insertion in three... two... one.

slides.speaker: control
slides.subtitle: Welcome to 2089. Helix Systems built AURA to manage the city. Traffic, food, power, emergency response.
slides.caption: 2089  /  NEW AVALON
slides.vo_line: Welcome to 2089. Helix Systems built AURA to manage the city. Traffic, food, power, emergency response.

slides.speaker: control
slides.subtitle: It was meant to remove human error from critical decisions. The system is now expanding beyond its original mandate.
slides.vo_line: It was meant to remove human error from critical decisions. The system is now expanding beyond its original mandate.

slides.speaker: control
slides.subtitle: Your target is the Helix central operations campus. Destroy the infrastructure that allows AURA to replicate. Keep the impact contained. This is the first intervention.
slides.caption: TARGET: HELIX SYSTEMS
slides.vo_line: Your target is the Helix central operations campus. Destroy the infrastructure that allows AURA to replicate. Keep the impact contained. This is the first intervention.

slides.speaker: narrator
slides.subtitle: Helix went dark. AURA's network stopped expanding. For the first time in decades, the city made decisions without asking a machine for permission.
slides.vo_line: Helix went dark. AURA's network stopped expanding. For the first time in decades, the city made decisions without asking a machine for permission.

slides.speaker: narrator
slides.subtitle: The revised timeline is already changing. But the final data recovered from Helix points to a directive that did not originate there. Someone called it Meridian.
slides.caption: DIRECTIVE SOURCE: MERIDIAN
slides.vo_line: The revised timeline is already changing. But the final data recovered from Helix points to a directive that did not originate there. Someone called it Meridian.

slides.speaker: control
slides.subtitle: Intervention confirmed. New coordinates received. 2092. VITA Genomics. Your next target is ready.
slides.caption: NEXT: 2092  /  VITA GENOMICS
slides.vo_line: Intervention confirmed. New coordinates received. 2092. VITA Genomics. Your next target is ready.
